name: Weaviate Agents
desc: Suite of agents that query, transform and improve data in Weaviate.
desc_zh: 在 Weaviate 中查询、转换和改进数据的智能体套件。
solves: Writing retrieval code for every new question does not scale; an agent takes the question and works the collection directly.
solves_zh: 每个新问题都写一遍检索代码无法扩展；智能体接问题，直接操作集合。
best_for: You want to ask a database questions in plain language instead of writing queries.
best_for_zh: 想用大白话向数据库提问，而不是写查询。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — weaviate.io/blog and product navigation）。 Post dated March 4, 2025 by Alvin Richards (VP of Product); the page states it was announced as a three-agent suite and that only the Query Agent reached general availability. Not in the ledger, so rule (b). 首次公开日期来源：https://weaviate.io/blog/weaviate-agents
